description:
Optimize the SEO metadata for two products in the WooCommerce store. 

1. Find the product 'Organic Cotton T-Shirt' (SKU: OCT-BLK-M). Change its URL Slug (Permalink) to 'organic-fair-trade-tee'. Update its Product Short Description to: 'Sustainably sourced, 100% organic cotton tee with a comfortable relaxed fit. Fair Trade Certified.'

2. Find the product 'Wireless Bluetooth Headphones' (SKU: WBH-001). Change its URL Slug (Permalink) to 'premium-anc-headphones'. Update its Product Short Description to: 'Industry-leading active noise cancellation with 30-hour battery life and plush ear cushions.'

Ensure you update/save both products after making changes.
